UPDATE block_manifest
               SET manifest_source = 'local'
             WHERE publisher = $1
               AND generation = $8
               AND version = $2
               AND coprocessor_context_id = $3
               AND host_chain_id = $4
               AND publication_block_number = $5
               AND publication_block_hash = $6
               AND revision = $7
               AND manifest_source = 'peer'
